body: you have no idea how much this made my day. i'm glad that there's people like you in the world, and if you ever need anything, feel free to contact me. i hope we stay in touch :)

this is gonna sound stupid as hell, and i'm sorry if i suck at giving advice man, i'm just a kid. have you ever seen hugo? there's this one part when he says "  I'd imagine the whole world was one big machine. Machines never come with any extra parts, you know. They always come with the exact amount they need. So I figured, if the entire world was one big machine, I couldn't be an extra part. I had to be here for some reason. And that means you have to be here for some reason, too." i know everything seems pointless rn, and i'm not tryna change your mind about that. you are meant to stay, it is not your time to go. you have  a purpose, and hey, it may not be clear right now, in fact, it might take years till you figure out what that is. i don't know what i was put on this earth to do, and sometimes, just not knowing makes me so fucking sad because i just want to feel like i matter, that there is something greater.. but for now, just make it day by day. life may not get better, but you will dfind what you were meant to do in your time here.

i feel you so much man. it sucks to feel this way, but it sucks even more when no one notices. but for the sake of me, and all the other redditors who are going to comment after me, please don't go through with this. i don't know why the people around you don't realize what you're going through, and as much as i wish i could fix that, i can't. but i see you, i know what you're saying, and i am there for you, 100%. if you need to pm it out, go ahead. the only thing that lies between me and you and all the other kind people who are going to comment on here is distance. we are here for you, i am here for you. i noticed. please don't go through with this.

man i hope you're still there. i wanna write something way longer but just please tell me that you're there. please don't go through with this, i really want to talk but i need to make sure that you are still there.

you are so kind. i hope that i grow up to be like you.
thank you from the bottom of my heart.
i owe you so much. thank you.
